# AfriDev - AI & Full Stack Software Development Agency

> AfriDev is a software engineering agency based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, specializing in cloud-native applications, AI/LLM integration, full-stack web and mobile development, and enterprise automation.

## Core Capabilities
- **AI & LLM Integration**: Custom RAG pipelines, fine-tuned LLM agents, intelligent chatbots, and AI workflow automation.
- **Full-Stack Web & Mobile Apps**: Modern Next.js, React, React Native, Node.js, and TypeScript applications built for speed and scale.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, GCP, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native architecture.
- **Enterprise Solutions**: High-performance backend microservices, API engineering, and digital transformation.
